description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D1x_zero_grad_bc driven by problems/advection_2d_x_zero_grad_central.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NX is the open metaparameter (NY is edge-closed at 8; the solution is constant in y and no y-operator appears), and the problem's dx observed and inlined x coordinates use the NX name so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. The manufactured steady solution cos(pi x) is zero-gradient-compatible (its odd x-derivatives vanish on the walls), so the 2nd-order one-sided face residual is superconvergent and the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.03 are clean interior O(dx^2) truncation drift (the short transport keeps the weakly non-normal one-sided operator in the linear-drift regime; derivation in the problem file).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
